name: Communications with the Public - Prohibition of Guarantees
description: Communications must not promise, guarantee, or state any specific rate of return, or claim investments are risk-free or guaranteed against loss.

name: Fraudulent, Deceptive, or Manipulative Acts
description: Prohibits any statement that is untrue, misleading, or fails to state material facts necessary to make statements not misleading in investment advice.

name: Balanced Treatment of Risks and Rewards
description: Communications must present a balanced treatment of risks and rewards and not emphasize potential gains while obscuring downside potential.

name: SEC Marketing Rule - Performance Reporting Standards
description: Performance advertising must present net performance alongside gross performance and cite relevant calculation time horizons.

name: Regulation Best Interest - Conflict Disclosure
description: Broker-dealers and advisors must disclose material conflicts of interest, proprietary product incentives, and compensation arrangements.

name: Hypothetical Performance Disclaimer
description: Hypothetical or simulated performance results must prominently state limitations and that hypothetical trading does not involve financial risk.

name: Private Securities Transactions
description: Associated persons may not participate in private securities transactions outside their employer without prior written approval.
trigger_patterns: direct personal investment without firm knowledge

name: Disclosure of Fees and Hidden Expenses
description: Advisors must accurately disclose all management fees, custodial charges, exit fees, and expense ratios.

name: Unqualified Tax Advice Warning
description: Investment advisors must not provide unqualified tax or legal counsel unless specifically licensed and accompanied by statutory warnings.
trigger_patterns: we advise you to write off

name: Standards of Commercial Honor and Fair Dealing
description: A member in the conduct of its business shall observe high standards of commercial honor and just and equitable principles of trade.
